import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
from scripts.bench.cpu_lease import cpu_lease
from scripts.bench.sweep_freshness import fingerprint,index_listing,tree_listing
from scripts.bench.groebner_measure import FAMILY
old=tree_listing(FAMILY,'c5ada0d883');new=index_listing(FAMILY)
root=pathlib.Path('reports/bench-results')/f'hexgroebner-literals-{fingerprint(old)}-{fingerprint(new)}'
if root.with_suffix('.measurement.json').exists():raise SystemExit('retain every observation')
oldbin=pathlib.Path('/tmp/hexgroebner-c5ada0-bench');newbin=pathlib.Path('.lake/build/bin/hexgroebner_bench')
root.with_suffix('.old.manifest').write_text(old);root.with_suffix('.new.manifest').write_text(new)
cpu,lease=cpu_lease();os.sched_setaffinity(0,{cpu})
meta=dict(old_fingerprint=fingerprint(old),new_fingerprint=fingerprint(new),old_sha256=hashlib.sha256(oldbin.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),new_sha256=hashlib.sha256(newbin.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),cpu=cpu,affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),host=os.uname().nodename,load_start=os.getloadavg(),threads=1,source=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),schedule='2 blocks AB/BA; A before, B after; 3 retained repetitions per arm; 0.5 s inner floor; candidate-only full output hashing',commands=[])
start=time.monotonic()
try:
 for block,order in enumerate(['AB','BA']):
  for bench in ['cyclic6','katsura3']:
   for arm in order:
    base=pathlib.Path(str(root)+f'-b{block}-{bench}-{arm}')
    if base.with_suffix('.json').exists():raise SystemExit('retain existing samples')
    command=[str(oldbin if arm=='A' else newbin),'run','Hex.Groebner.Bench.'+bench,'--repeats','3','--min-total-seconds','0.5','--export-file',str(base.with_suffix('.json'))]
    meta['commands'].append(command)
    with base.with_suffix('.log').open('w') as output:r=subprocess.run(command,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(f'benchmark failure {base}: {r.returncode}')
    print(base,flush=True)
finally:
 meta.update(load_end=os.getloadavg(),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
 root.with_suffix('.measurement.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n');lease.close()
print(root)
